verdict.rationale: The Florida Department of Revenue is a government tax-administration agency whose online services are e-file/e-pay and registration portals, not an AI agent or assistant host. Acting as an MCP client that plugs in external tool servers is outside this kind of product, so the question is a category error. Nothing in the evidence shows any AI or agent runtime that could consume MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
